Six synthetic checks passed in each build: managed arithmetic, repeated seeded runtime Random sequence, x64 execution, GDI pixel assertions, PNG round trip and offscreen Panel rendering. A deliberate stderr message and exit7 propagated correctly. All seven final capability probes passed; original solution builds, simulation tests and trials were not run.

The two initial failures remain preserved; all scratch trees were removed and cleanup verified.
